V1 REVIEW POLISH (2026-09-11-153355-review.md, verdict APPROVED, 2 issues addressed):

Issue 1 (momentum-lookback window mismatch) -> FIXED by aligning both paths on ONE source. Root cause: backtest.py had a stale module constant MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK=6 driving compute_momentum_direction/compute_momentum_magnitude and the per-trade tuning context, while the live SignalGenerator._compute_momentum_magnitude and the AutoOptimizer default both used momentum_lookback=8. So the tuner optimized a 6-bar world while the live generator ran an 8-bar one. Fix: changed backtest.py MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK to derive from DataConfig().momentum_lookback (=8) instead of the literal 6, making DataConfig.momentum_lookback the single source of truth shared by (a) the live generator's confidence/direction helpers, (b) the backtest engine, and (c) AutoOptimizer (which tunes momentum_lookback within AutoOptimizerConfig.momentum_range=(5,10) and defaults to 8). Both sites now carry comments documenting the shared window. 8 (not 6) is the correct target: DataConfig default, AutoOptimizer default, AND every test_backtester.py comment already assume 8 ('Need 8+ bars for MOMENTUM_LOOKBACK=8', 'close[8]-close[0]', '>$3.00 in 8 bars'). Verified: the three compute_momentum_direction test cases (SELL/-3.5, FLAT/1.0, BUY/2.01 over close[8]-close[0]) all yield the asserted result under an 8-bar window (checked via pure-Python reproduction, since pandas is uninstallable offline); test_buy_at_threshold_plus_epsilon still returns BUY. py_compile OK for backtest.py + signal_generator.py; DataConfig().momentum_lookback confirmed == 8 at runtime.

Issue 2 (AutoOptimizer overrides mutate shared config in place with no reset) -> CONFIRMED INTENTIONAL, documented (no snapshot/restore added, judged not beneficial). Added a detailed comment at the get_current_params() override site in signal_generator.generate_signal explaining the intended lifecycle: the AutoOptimizer is the single source of truth for tuned params, persists to auto_optimizer_state.json, shifts <=1 clamped step per cycle, and rolls back to pre-tuning values on measured regression (_check_rollback). Because get_current_params() returns the optimizer's *current authoritative* values on every call, re-applying them each signal RE-SYNCS the generator's config to that authoritative state (a rollback/convergence is reflected on the next signal) rather than accumulating unbounded monotonic drift. This is exactly the user's 'backtest locally so it can tweak itself and stay tuned' intent; a per-cycle snapshot/restore was deliberately NOT added because it adds complexity against the 'super simple' directive and provides no benefit when the optimizer already owns and bounds the parameter state (the only reset path is clearing optimizer state / process restart). CSV contract unchanged (model_name='momentum', 9 fields); no ML/RL code reintroduced.
